# `DrawnEngine`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Arbitrary\DrawnEngine`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Arbitrary/DrawnEngine.php#L23) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** `Random\Engine`

A `Random\Engine` whose output is drawn from the property's own
replay tape: every generate() is one in-body Gen::draw() of
eight bytes, so the random decisions of the code under test are recorded,
replayed by position on shrink trials, and shrunk through the bytes' own
tree toward `"\0"` — which `Random\Randomizer` maps to the lower end
of a range and to near-identity shuffles.

Valid only inside a property run, like [`Gen`](/api/classes/Gen)::draw(): outside one the
first `generate()` throws. Not seedable — the tape is the seed.

## Methods

### generate()

```php
generate(): string
```

Eight bytes from the tape: one in-body draw of Gen::bytes().

**Throws:**

- `RuntimeException` — Outside a property run, like \Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Gen::draw().
